SERVICESFive families · Bangladesh and international

What you receive.

Policy research, advocacy and management consultancy — built on one integrated capability: economics, data stories, technology and research, applied to the decision in front of you.

F1

Feasibility studies & project preparation

Feasibility studiesProposal makingImplementation-ready packages

Feasibility studies and project preparation that give an approving body what it needs to decide: technical, financial, economic, social and market feasibility, costed implementation and financing plans, and results frameworks — in the approving institution’s own format.

Open →F2

Cost-benefit & financial analysis

Economic cost-benefit analysisFinancial analysisEnvironmental and social benefitsCosting and financing

Economic and financial appraisal that tells a funder whether a project is worth its cost — ENPV, EIRR, FNPV, FIRR, benefit-cost ratios and switching values, costed and financed, and built to the approving institution’s guidelines.

Open →F3

Policy research & advocacy — Bangladesh & international

Policy research, BangladeshPolicy research, internationalAdvocacy and policy engagementEvidence-driven policy making

Policy research for Bangladesh and the region that is designed to be used: survey and qualitative evidence, gap and constraint analysis, policy briefs, and structured dialogue with the people who decide.

Open →F4

Management consulting, M&E & evaluation

Management consultancyInstitutional reformMonitoring and evaluationImpact evaluation and RCTs

Management consulting for public programmes and institutions: results frameworks and measurement systems, impact evaluations including randomised trials, and the governance, financing and investment plans that let an institution deliver.

Open →F5

Data stories & decision technology

Data storiesSurveys and datasetsDatabases and indicesDigital, AI and GIS appraisal

Data and technology put to work on a decision: firm and household surveys, policy databases and indices, appraisal of digital and AI programmes, GIS-informed pipelines — and reports that turn the data into a story someone can act on.
